# Groups list UI integration (2026-01-29 20:28Z)

_**User**_

I want to move the GROUPS list from its separate "Groups" tab to below the device list. There should be a divider between devices and groups. The + button of the groups tab should be there in the section below the devices as well - is that possible? if so how - all features of devies and groups should be preserved

miataru App – Feature and Developer Guide\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nThis document lists all features offered by the miataru iOS app. Each item is described twice: once for **users** and once for **developers**. The descriptions also outline how the feature behaves in the interface so the flow from view to view is clear.\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## App Navigation and Views\\\\\\\\n**For users:**\\\\\\\\n- The app launches to a tab bar with **Devices**, **Groups**, **QR**, and **Settings** tabs. Each tab retains its own navigation stack, so returning to a tab restores where you left off.\\\\\\\\n- Tapping a device or group drills into dedicated map screens, while the QR tab always displays your personal code for quick sharing.\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n- On iPad, you can open a device in a new window from the list or map via context menu, or by dragging the item toward the screen edge.\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n**For developers:**\\\\\\\\n- &#96;iPhone_RootView&#96; constructs the &#96;TabView&#96; and hosts &#96;iPhone_DevicesView&#96;, &#96;iPhone_GroupsView&#96;, &#96;iPhone_MyDeviceQRCodeView&#96;, and &#96;iPhone_SettingsView&#96;.\\\\\\\\n- &#96;MiataruRootView&#96; selects platform‑specific root containers so iPad and Mac can embed their own navigation styles.\\\\\\\\n- iPad supports opening device detail windows using a value‑based &#96;WindowGroup(for: String)&#96; and context menu/drag interactions.\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## Location Tracking\\\\\\\\n**For users:**\\\\\\\\n- Enable background and foreground tracking in *Settings* to share your location with a Miataru server.\\\\\\\\n- The app sends updates even with the screen locked and records a log of recent updates.\\\\\\\\n- Location sharing can store history on the server and works offline until network connectivity resumes.\\\\\\\\n- Tracking accuracy, activity type, and sensitivity are configurable in *Settings*, and a \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Location Tracking Details\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\" page shows the last GPS and server updates.\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n- When supported by your device/client, the app also submits altitude (above sea level), speed, and battery level with location updates.\\\\\\\\n- Visual effects such as pulsing accuracy circles and shimmering indicators pause automatically in Low Power Mode or while the app is in the background.\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n**For developers:**\\\\\\\\n- &#96;LocationManager&#96; publishes the current location, permission state, server update status, altitude, speed, battery level (when available), and a log of recent updates. It switches between high‑accuracy updates in the foreground and significant‑change monitoring in the background, requests authorization when needed, and uploads data using &#96;MiataruAPIClient&#96;.\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\"signatures\\\\\\\":{},\\\\\\\"detailedLines\\\\\\\":[{\\\\\\\"text\\\\\\\":\\\\\\\"# miataru App – Feature and Developer Guide\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\"lineNumber\\\\\\\":1},{\\\\\\\"lineNumber\\\\\\\":2},{\\\\\\\"text\\\\\\\":\\\\\\\"This document lists all features offered by the miataru iOS app. Each item is described twice: once for **users** and once for **developers**. Fixed the navigation type mismatch by switching the stack path to a single enum destination type for both devices and groups. Now both device and group `NavigationLink` entries target the same `NavigationStack` path type, so tapping a group works.

What changed in `iPhone_DevicesView`:
- `navigationPath` is now `[NavigationDestination]` instead of `[String]`
- Both device and group links use `NavigationDestination`
- One `navigationDestination(for:)` handles both cases

Key snippet:
```31:88:/Users/bietiekay/code/miataru-ios-app/miataru/miataru/views/iPhone/iPhone_DevicesView.swift
NavigationStack(path: $navigationPath) {
    List {
        Section {
            ForEach(store.devices) { device in
                if editMode == .inactive {
                    NavigationLink(value: NavigationDestination.device(device.DeviceID)) {
                        DeviceRowView(device: device, cache: cache)
                    }
                    // ...
                }
            }
        }
        Section {
            ForEach(groupStore.groups) { group in
                NavigationLink(value: NavigationDestination.group(group.id)) {
                    GroupRowView(group: group)
                }
                // ...
            }
        }
    }
}
```
